title: Dithyrambic
summary: DITHYRAMBIC, noun 1. A song in honor of Bacchus, in which the wildness of intoxication is imitated. 2. Any poem written in wild enthusiastic strains. DITHYRAMBIC, adjective Wild; enthusiastic.
